d365_build.name: d365_build
d365_build.description: Start a package build job. Poll d365_job, then read diagnostics with d365_results(kind=compile).

dry_run.description: Show the command without starting the job.

d365_results.name: d365_results
d365_results.description: Read the latest compile, best-practice or sync diagnostics. Match the result's file and time to your run.

module.description: Package name. Required for compile and best_practice. Ignored for sync.

warnings.description: Include warnings. Defaults to true for best_practice, false otherwise.

d365_db_sync.name: d365_db_sync
d365_db_sync.description: Start a database sync job. Poll d365_job, then read the sync log with d365_results(kind=sync).

modules.description: Package names. Omit or pass an empty list for a full sync.

dry_run.description: Show the command without starting the job.

d365_best_practice.name: d365_best_practice
d365_best_practice.description: Start a model check job. Poll d365_job, then call d365_results(kind=best_practice).

dry_run.description: Show the command without starting the job.

d365_run.name: d365_run
d365_run.description: Run PowerShell in the D365 session. For a background run, poll d365_job. Output masks labelled credentials.

command.description: d365fo.tools command or short PowerShell script.

timeout.description: Foreground seconds, 1–600 with a lower service cap where configured. Ignored in the background.

background.description: Return a job ID instead of waiting for output.

d365_job.name: d365_job
d365_job.description: Read jobs or wait for one to finish. Omit job_id to list. stop changes job state and needs a writer.

job_id.description: ID returned by a D365 job tool.

tail_lines.description: Output lines to keep, 1–400 when a job ID is given.

stop.description: Request termination. Requires job_id and zero wait_seconds.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for one job. Zero reads status immediately. A service may set a lower limit.

d365_logs.name: d365_logs
d365_logs.description: Read one D365 log source (UTC). Read-only. A cut scan's note gives until/until_skip.

source.description: batch reads job/task history and infologs. process reads execution messages. iis reads AOSService W3C logs. events selects WAS, Application Error, .NET Runtime, IIS-W3SVC-WP, Dynamics*, Management Reporter* or text naming AOSService/Batch.exe/w3wp in Application/System. Application Error needs a D365 app/module.

since.description: Start inclusive, 1–43,200 minutes back or an ISO time in the past 30 days. Default 60 minutes. Use ISO since/until for the same window across calls. Minutes move per call.

level.description: Minimum severity: warning includes errors, all includes every level. For batch, error matches status Error or error infolog entries. A Finished task can carry errors. Use status=error for failed tasks only.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of text, captions, process names or IIS paths. At most 1,000 characters.

group.description: Group repeats with first, last, distinct variants. count counts records/tasks, not distinct business failures. Normalize numbers, GUIDs and times.

until.description: End exclusive, 1–43,200 minutes back or an ISO time in the past 30 days. Defaults to now.

job.description: Batch or process only. Case-insensitive substring of a job/task caption or process name, up to 200 characters.

status.description: Batch only. Case-insensitive task status (hold, waiting, executing, error, finished, ready, notrun, cancelling, canceled, scheduled).

until_skip.description: Scan-note cursor: includes until, skips this many rows already seen there.

d365_sql.name: d365_sql
d365_sql.description: Run SQL against the box database. The script can write. Read row sets or affected counts for each GO batch.

sql.description: SQL script. Put GO on its own line between batches.

timeout.description: Seconds for the entire script. A service may set a lower limit and shorten the 60-second default.

atomic.description: Run all batches in one transaction.

database.description: SQL database on the configured instance.

xref.name: xref
xref.description: Read compiled D365 references. Find a path with names before asking for references. Use hierarchy for classes.

what.description: info lists index details. names and hierarchy need name. references needs path.

name.description: For names, give an element, label ID or path prefix ending in *. For hierarchy, give a class or interface name.

path.description: For references, use the exact path returned by names, or a label ID.

element_type.description: For names, narrow an element name to a folder or type such as Classes, Tables or DataEntityView. Surrounding slashes are accepted.

direction.description: For references, used_by (default) or uses. For hierarchy, down (default) or up. Empty uses the default.

kind.description: Reference kind such as call or extends. The info result also lists the kinds.

members.description: For references, include names below the path.

limit.description: Maximum rows. names and references allow up to 500, hierarchy up to 1,000.

offset.description: Skip this many reference rows. Add rows shown to continue. Offset plus limit must be at most 10,000.
